annotations.annotation: The bar chart illustrates the average performance of three different models labeled as Base, CORG, and AdaCAD. The horizontal axis contains the categories, labeled with the names of each model. The vertical axis, labeled "Average Performance", represents the performance values with a linear scale ranging from 48 to 62, with tick intervals of 2 units. Each model is represented by two stacked bars, with the lower section in gray indicating "Standard" and the upper section in blue representing "Ours". The Base model has a total height around 59, with the blue section being the only component. The CORG model consists of both a gray section, approximately half the height of the bar, and a blue section, reaching a total near 59. The AdaCAD model, similarly to the Base model, reaches a height of approximately 60, with a significant portion in blue, following the gray section. The bars are not sorted in any specific order and do not have additional visual emphasis such as shading or bolding. The legend at the top-left corner of the chart distinguishes between the "Standard" and "Ours" components of each stacked bar.
